answer.rationale: Roll out the already-confirmed SMB signup simplification to reduce friction and improve activation while the price attack increases churn pressure. In the directly relevant SMB evidence, simplification increased activation (+9%) and qualified revenue (+4%) with only a -1% 30-day retention change. Do not counter with promotional pricing: the recovered source behind memory_73 showed +18% qualified revenue but -12% 30-day retention, making it unsuitable for the stated sustainable-revenue objective despite short-term acquisition gains. Evidence remains limited to SMB and does not prove that onboarding changes alone will offset price-driven churn.
